'''Reyal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed aboard [[Adamas Space Station]], orbiting the planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Around [[3642 BBY]], he approached an Imperial traveler and asked him to find [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Halpern]], who would brief the individual about the situation. Later on, he supplied the Imperial with proper clothes for traveling in Hoth's surface.
